repository_epoch_may_advance: Authorized root source edits outside pinned executable; source assertion is exact immutable snapshot and executable, not concurrent repository stability
scope: Actual owned GTK controls/XTest keys; disposable SQLite backup; worker-caption-triggered native Close/reopen/indexed last product; transient loading sampling reported separately and exact persisted bytes/generation. Not performance measurement or forced worker-error injection.

checks.name: startup retains exact original payload and generation
actual scoped AT-SPI native header Close activation closes copied dialog with exact State and generation

private_gtk_animation_policy: Animations disabled in disposable XDG_CONFIG_HOME to make close lifetime independent of transition duration. Retained default-animation attempts are distinct.
manager_setup: Existing SARV_EXPAND capture hook opens original manager expander; Composer opening and cancellation use actual keyboard controls.
native_close_input: Owned Composer header Close via actual AT-SPI action; no keyboard activation/focus claim for nonfocusable native window-control button.
transient_loading_sampling_limit: Previous default-motion full/scoped AT-SPI walks returned after Ready; neither loading visibility nor weak-discard branch is inferred if not directly observed.
